title: hub pair response
description: Response of a successful POST /hub/v1/pair (PLAN.md S07 pairing, S20 Fleet link, T913). The request is the pair_request of S07 with the client kind homeassistant or tool. The token is the fleet token: 32 random bytes as base64url without padding, shown exactly once, stored by the hub only as a hash. scope says what the token may see and control: every agent (type all) or the agents that carry at least one of the tags (type tags). fingerprint is the SHA-256 fingerprint of the hub certificate for pinning; it is absent when the hub is served without TLS. Failures use HTTP status codes with the body {error: {code, message}}: 400 bad_request, 401 unauthorized (wrong or expired code), 429 rate_limited.
